issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo contains none, so the documented tiny demo cannot regenerate outputs.
The end-to-end test exercises extraction from the missing story corpus and fails in a clean checkout.
Extraction assumes every configured emotion produced data and crashes with KeyError/stack errors instead of validating dataset completeness up front.
Empty or invalid story configurations crash via min(start_positions) or stories[0] rather than returning an actionable configuration error.
Validation loads vectors from the manifest but builds a backend from current CLI config without checking backend/model/layer/dimension compatibility.
Preference steering also skips artifact compatibility checks, so stale or mismatched vectors can be used with the wrong backend.
Custom emotion sets with no matching built-in scenarios fail with a low-level numpy stack error or produce invalid means.
If the afraid vector is absent, the dosage probe silently uses the first emotion vector while still writing afraid_* outputs.
HF steering falls back to steering every prompt token when tokenizer offsets are unavailable, changing behavior substantially without warning.
HF preference scoring uses only the first token of ' good' and ' bad', which can be wrong for tokenizers that split either label.
Configuration values are coerced but not semantically validated, allowing empty emotion lists, negative counts, invalid thresholds, and unsupported dtype strings.
steering.min_reported_emotions is configured but ignored; steer_prefs hard-codes the four-emotion behavior.
